title: HTML DOM Tag Validator
real_world_story:

problem_statement: Given a sequence of N tokenized HTML tags, verify whether every opening tag has a matching closing tag properly nested in LIFO order. An opening tag has the format '<tag>' and its corresponding closing tag is '</tag>' where 'tag' is a lowercase string. Self-closing tags are not present. If the markup is valid, print 'VALID'. If a violation occurs, print 'INVALID <index>' where <index> is the 1-based token index of the first mismatched tag. If the document ends with unclosed tags, print 'INVALID <N+1>'.
task: Validate the nesting of N HTML tag tokens and print VALID or INVALID <index>.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer N, the number of tag tokens.
The second line contains N space-separated tag tokens.
output_format: Print 'VALID' if the document is properly nested and closed, or 'INVALID <index>' if an error is encountered.

constraints.tag_format: Starts with '<' and ends with '>'. Lowercase tag names.
